submission.reasoning: On workstation5, an interactive cmd.exe (proc-23dc9b1636) run by WORKSTATION5\wardog at high integrity wrote a batch file to C:\Users\wardog\AppData\Local\Temp\art.bat. It then started reg.exe (proc-55d9f85e37) with: REG ADD HKCU\Environment /v UserInitMprLogonScript /d ...\Temp\art.bat /f. That sets the batch file as a logon script, so it will run every time wardog logs on. This is logon-script persistence (MITRE T1037.001). The file name art.bat matches what Atomic Red Team uses to test this technique, so this may be a planned test. It is still a working autostart entry and needs to be removed. Assumption: I did not fetch the cmd.exe write relation, so the link between cmd.exe and art.bat is inferred, not confirmed.
